The checked-in bootstrap JAR is the official Gradle **8.14.3 wrapper**, which
runs on Java 8 and verifies `distributionSha256Sum`. It downloads and launches
**Gradle 2.14.1**, the version used by ForgeGradle 2.1, not Gradle 8.

Wrapper source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gradle/gradle/v8.14.3/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar

Published wrapper SHA-256:
`7d3a4ac4de1c32b59bc6a4eb8ecb8e612ccd0cf1ae1e99f66902da64df296172`

Verification source: https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.14.3-wrapper.jar.sha256
